trace.question: List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not within the normal range.
trace.evidence: List refers to GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ID); total bilirubin (T-BIL) not within normal range refers to T-BIL > = 2.0

attempts.sql:
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS ID_List
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX

trace.final_sql:
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS ID_List
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX
trace.answer: Patients with abnormal total bilirubin (T-BIL) levels are grouped by sex: females are IDs 250391, 1180510, 2308236, 2931207, and 4862013, while males are IDs 43003, 444499, 1137040, 2307640, and 4618443.
